relevance.rationale: Join CORRECT (Cantarella, DeTurck and Gluck, 'The Biot-Savart operator for application to knot theory, fluid dynamics, and plasma physics', J. Math. Phys. 42, 876 (2001), DOI 10.1063/1.1329659 - matching the registered entry's authors and year). BIB ORPHAN: full-tree grep returns zero hits outside folio/schema/references.ts. The paper is the Euclidean-space companion of deturck-gluck2008 (also in this slice, also uncited): it develops the Biot-Savart operator on a domain, its self-adjointness and image characterisation, and the resulting helicity and curl-eigenvalue estimates. The folio has three live blocks in this exact area - rem:townsend-biot-savart-strain, rem:helicity-physical and rem:vorticity-lower-bound-argument - none of which cites it. Supporting rather than core: the blocks argue about Biot-Savart strain and helicity bounds and would be strengthened by the operator-theoretic source, but no folio result currently depends on a theorem of this paper. Note the uploaded file is the AIP scitation front-matter version; the text layer begins with the citation banner, so I have identified it from that banner and the abstract page rather than from a full read.

keyResults.statement: Operator-theoretic development of the Biot-Savart operator on domains, with the helicity and first-curl-eigenvalue estimates it yields, framed for knot theory, fluid dynamics and plasma physics.
keyResults.useForFolio: The Euclidean baseline against which the hyperbolic-space version (deturck-gluck2008) is the generalisation; together they would let rem:vorticity-lower-bound-argument state which ambient geometry its bound is taken in.
